Hi Sadaf,

This sounds like a more Shiny general question as opposed to one regarding hosting a Shiny application on shinyapps.io, so I am cross-posting to the shiny-discuss list.

On Tue, Nov 8, 2016 at 10:33 AM Sadaf Naz <sadafn...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi,

I'm using MySQL 'world' database. My app is fetching table from a database. The app is also working on column selection using checkbox option. I want to filter result row-wise further. Tabs for row options for two columns are appearing in the output, but not filtering row-wise results. My code is attached. I know a small piece of code which should be in server section, but don't know how to fit that part to make it work. Please help me to figure out a suitable option. Thank you.

Sadaf
#Navigation
rm(list=ls(all=TRUE))
library(shiny)
library(DBI)
library(ggplot2)

conn <- dbConnect(drv = RMySQL::MySQL(),dbname = "world",host = "localhost",username = "root",password = "xxxx")
rs <- dbSendQuery(conn = conn, 'select * from city')
Data <-fetch(rs, n=-1)

# Define the overall UI
ui<-fluidPage(
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      conditionalPanel(
        'input.dataset === "Data"',
        checkboxGroupInput('show_vars', p(style = "font-family:Arial Black", "Select columns:"),
                           names(Data), selected = names(Data))
      ),
      # Create a new Row in the UI for selectInputs
      fluidRow(p(style = "font-family:Arial Black", "Select rows:")
      ),
      fluidRow(
        column(6,
               selectInput("nam",
                           "Name:",
                           c("All",
                             unique(as.character(Data$Name))))
        )),
      fluidRow(
        column(6,
               selectInput("cc",
                           "CountryCode:",
                           c("All",
                             unique(as.character(Data$CountryCode))))
        )
      )
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      tabsetPanel(
        id = 'dataset',
        tabPanel('Data', DT::dataTableOutput('mytable1'))
      )
    )
  )
)
#server
server<-function(input, output) {
  
  # choose columns to display
  output$mytable1 <- DT::renderDataTable({
    DT::datatable(Data[, input$show_vars, drop = FALSE])
  })
}
shinyApp(ui, server)


# Missing code that should be in server section somewhere is given below. Please help me to fit this piece of code. Or any other option to make this app working for both column and row selection/navigation. Thank you.
Missing code:                        if (input$nam != "All") {
                         Data <- Data[Data$Name == input$nam,]
                       }
                       if (input$cc != "All") {
                         Data <- Data[Data$CountryCode == input$cc,]
                       }
                       Data
